issue.title: ipc: data race on `m_block_template` members
issue.body:
If a client submits a command to one worker thread that writes to `m_block_template` via [`submitSolution`](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/badc9574810c23c05ac17a5285c2edf416d2d66b/src/node/interfaces.cpp#L917) while a client submits a separate command to another worker thread that reads via any of the reading methods like [`getBlockHeader`](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/badc9574810c23c05ac17a5285c2edf416d2d66b/src/node/interfaces.cpp#L889), a data race occurs.

I'm not sure if this is intended behavior or if well-behaved clients would submit commands like this for separate worker threads?
